cohort: 1043 patients who underwent cesarean section for macrosomia (birth weight ≥ 4000 g)
finding: Macrosomic neonates delivered via cesarean section under general anesthesia had higher rates of low Apgar scores, while mothers experienced a greater decrease in hematocrit and higher blood transfusion rates compared to those who received spinal anesthesia.
mod_finding: This study found that macrosomic neonates delivered via cesarean section under general anesthesia had higher rates of low Apgar scores compared to those delivered under spinal anesthesia.
